title: US-19701 external criteria (FBS-234)

testCases.description: rcf build verdict review --code MERGE --adequacy PASS --by "reviewer and codex" at a clean HEAD exits 0, prints "verdict: review MERGE/PASS at <H7> written to rcf/verdicts/<H12>/review.json" and writes a ReviewVerdict v1 for H without committing
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/build-verdict-rounds.test.js::AC-19701-1: rcf build verdict review --code MERGE --adequacy PASS --by "reviewer and codex" at a clean HEAD exits 0, prints "verdict: review MERGE/PASS at <H7> written to rcf/verdicts/<H12>/review.json" and writes a ReviewVerdict v1 for H without committing

testCases.description: --adequacy FINDINGS with a spec and a build --finding records adequacy FINDINGS and findings F-1 (spec, AC-101-1) and F-2 (build, acId null)

testCases.description: FINDINGS with no --finding exits 2, a malformed --finding exits 2 naming the <spec|build>:<AC id|->:<text> form, an unscoped --acs exits 3 with the brokenReference line, and none writes a verdict file

testCases.description: a dirty tree refuses with exit 4 "verdict refused: working tree is dirty; a verdict names a committed head", and a second review for the same head refuses with exit 4 leaving the first file byte-identical

testCases.description: rcf build verdict review writes only rcf/verdicts/<H12>/review.json, never commits, never edits an existing verdict file and spawns only git
